name: vspilink
description: Connect Codex on the same machine to a running VSPiLink MCP bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Control a local workspace through VSPiLink
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a VSPiLink server listening on the same machine. VSPiLink supplies OAuth-protected file, Git, execution, collaboration, and supervised-agent tools.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current workspace and summarize its state.
Run the safe checks and explain every failure.
Coordinate agents on this workspace and show progress.
